name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃） prevention 插件。v0.1.8 修复了 v0.1.7 引入的回归：顶层 await 导致 Host 半边打包失败。自动检测 + 退出后自动清理：周期性读 Cookies 库大小，检测到堆积时自动登记 Windows 计划任务，在你完全退出 DSH 后 ≤10 分钟自动运行 cleanup-once.ps1。同时提供「账户 → 设置 → Cookie 清理」分区。Layer A（cookieMaxAgeDays:7）已在生效。 / DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431) prevention. v0.1.8 fixes the v0.1.7 regression where a top-level await broke the Host half bundle. Auto-detect via DB size + deferred auto-cleanup through a Task Scheduler job after DSH fully exits. No runtime deletion (sandbox + locked DB), genuine prevention without manual steps.
